name: @stillfail/station
description: The still.fail station: its TypeScript (tests and development), the MoonBit station in mb/, its native parts in native/

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/skills && cp -R assets/skills/. dist/skills/ && cp assets/agents/claude-tui.mjs assets/agents/dsh-bridge.mjs assets/agents/cursor-bridge.mjs assets/agents/pi-bridge.mjs assets/agents/sandbox-bridge.mjs assets/agents/colab-sandbox.mjs assets/agents/repo-rules-hook.mjs assets/agents/subagent-hook.mjs assets/screens/linux-portal.py assets/screens/linux-x11.py assets/screens/linux-gamepad.py assets/screens/scrcpy-server dist/ && cp src/agents/copilot-bridge.mjs dist/
scripts.build:node: pnpm run build && esbuild src/main.ts --outbase=src --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outdir=dist --external:*.node --banner:js="import { createRequire as __bundleCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __bundleCreateRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild ../bin/admin-cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=dist/admin-cli.js
scripts.test: node ../scripts/native.ts run mesh runner archive-rs reader reader-harness launcher -- node --import ./test/setup-env.mjs --test --test-timeout=600000 test/*.test.ts
scripts.test:side: node ../scripts/native.ts run mesh runner archive-rs reader iroh-relay mesh-relay -- node --import ./test/setup-env.mjs --test --test-concurrency=1 side/*.test.ts
